title: Reconciliar frontier durable de Live con trabajo efectivamente ejecutable
mission: Make Prometeo Live project-guide frontier state self-consistent with durable job outcomes and allocator semantics. Reconcile STATE.frontier_refs against current portfolio/feed state so terminal jobs do not remain counted as live frontier, capability-bound unresolved jobs remain visible as explicit blockers instead of being duplicated, and planners can replenish genuinely executable work without revisiting already VERIFIED/DONE jobs.
definition_of_done: Add a deterministic reconciliation/check that classifies each project-guide frontier ref as executable/active, capability-requirement, terminal, or missing from current durable portfolio state.
Terminal VERIFIED/DONE work is not retained as live executable frontier and cannot satisfy frontier_min_per_project merely because STATE.json still references it.
Capability-bound unresolved jobs remain referenced/evidenced and are not cloned into duplicate browser-verification jobs.

Regression fixture covers Prometeo Live revision-1 shape: one terminal reproduction-metric ref plus two browser/publication capability-bound refs; effective executable frontier is below target and replenishment remains justified.
Regression preserves ordinary projects whose frontier contains at least two current executable jobs.
Any STATE mutation uses monotonic CAS semantics; no Current, Human Accepted or Served pointer changes.
